items.problem: WinUI 3 scaffold enables <Nullable>enable</Nullable> over nullable-disabled UWP source, producing a wave of CS8618/CS8625 warnings on ported code-behind that the dev-agent had to clean up manually.
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl T34: 16x CS8618/CS8625 (e.g. 'Scenario1_DataEvents.xaml.cs(45,16): warning CS8618 ... customSensor'); lessons.json errors_encountered + dev_agent_struggles (T29, T38).
items.root_cause: Skill mentioned <Nullable>enable</Nullable> only once, scoped to a single App.MainWindow field (MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md:186); no general rule that all ported UWP code trips the nullable analyzer.
items.change: Added a concise '### Nullable reference types' subsection to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md naming the recurring warnings (CS8618 deferred-init fields, CS8625/CS8602 null literals) and the standard fixes (nullable-annotate deferred-init fields; null-forgive only where lifecycle guarantees a value).
items.expected_effect: Dev-agent writes nullable-correct fields on the first pass, eliminating the CS8618/CS8625 warning wave and the extra edit passes.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, dotnet build emits 0 CS8618/CS8625/CS8602 warnings for ported code-behind (vs 16 here), and no dedicated nullable-cleanup turns appear in build-events.jsonl.

items.problem: x:Bind against a const/static member (FEATURE_NAME) failed the build with CS0176, the only hard build error in the trial.
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl T34: 'MainPage.g.cs(146,50): error CS0176: Member MainPage.FEATURE_NAME cannot be accessed with an instance reference'; T35-T36 fix.
items.root_cause: The x:Bind section (MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md:683-685) covered only namespace/type-not-found failures, saying nothing about static/const binding resolving to an illegal instance path.
items.change: Added one sentence to the existing '### x:Bind and compiled bindings' section: static/const targets emit CS0176 under x:Bind; type-qualify ({x:Bind local:MainPage.FEATURE_NAME}) or expose an instance wrapper property.
items.expected_effect: Dev-agent type-qualifies or wraps static/const x:Bind targets, avoiding CS0176 on the first build.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, no CS0176 error appears in build-events.jsonl and the first dotnet build of the shell succeeds.
